\[11.4.37\] \[\int_{0}^{\infty}J_{\mu}(at)\cos bt dt = \frac{\cos\left[\mu\arcsin\frac{b}{a}\right]}{(a^{2}\!-\!b^{2})^{ \ddagger}}\quad\quad(0\!\leq b\!<\!a)\] \[= \frac{-a^{\mu}\sin\frac{\pi\mu}{2}}{(b^{2}\!-\!a^{2})^{\ddagger}[b +(b^{2}\!-\!a^{2})^{\ddagger}]^{a}}\] \[(b\!>\!\!a\!>\!0)\quad\quad(\mathscr{R}\mu\!\!>\!\!-1)\] \[\int_{0}^{\infty}J_{\mu}(at)\sin bt dt = \frac{\sin\left[\mu\arcsin\frac{b}{a}\right]}{(a^{2}\!-\!b^{2})^{ \ddagger}}\quad\quad(0\!\leq b\!<\!a)\] \[= \frac{a^{\mu}\cos\frac{\pi\mu}{2}}{(b^{2}\!-\!a^{2})^{\ddagger}[b +(b^{2}\!-\!a^{2})^{\ddagger}]^{a}}\] \[(b\!>\!\!a\!>\!\!0)\quad\quad(\mathscr{R}\mu\!\!>\!\!-2)\] \[11.4.39\quad\int_{0}^{\infty}e^{i\eta t}J_{0}(at)dt = \frac{1}{(a^{2}\!-\!b^{2})^{\ddagger}}\quad\quad(0\!\leq b\!<\! a)\] \[= \frac{i}{(b^{2}\!-\!a^{2})^{\ddagger}}\quad\quad(0\!<\!\!a\!<\! b)\] \[\int_{0}^{\infty}\!e^{i\eta t}Y_{0}(at)dt = \frac{2i}{\pi(a^{2}\!-\!b^{2})^{\ddagger}}\arcsin\frac{b}{a}\quad \quad(0\!\leq b\!<\!a)\] \[= \frac{-1}{(b^{2}\!-\!a^{2})^{\ddagger}}\!+\!\frac{2i}{\pi(b^{2}\!- \!a^{2})^{\ddagger}}\] \[\times\!\ln\,\left\{\frac{b\!-\!(b^{2}\!-\!a^{2})^{\ddagger}}{a} \right\}\,\,(0\!<\!\!a\!<\!b)\] \[\int_{0}^{\infty}\!t^{\mu\to r+1}J_{\mu}(at)J_{\nu}(bt)dt = 0\quad\quad\quad\quad(0\!<\!\!b\!<\!a)\] \[= \frac{2^{\mu\to r+1}a^{\mu}(b^{2}\!-\!a^{2})^{\mu-\mu-1}}{b^{*} \Gamma(r\!-\!\mu)}\] \[(b\!>\!\!a\!>\!\!0)\] \[(\mathscr{R}\nu\!\!>\!\!\mathscr{R}\mu\!\!>\!\!-1)\] \[11.4.42\quad\int_{0}^{\infty}\!J_{\mu}(at)J_{\nu-1}(bt)dt = \frac{b^{\mu-1}}{a^{\mu}}\quad\quad(0\!<\!\!b\!<\!a)\] \[= \frac{1}{2b}\quad\quad\quad(0\!<\!\!b\!=\!a)\] \[= 0\quad\quad\quad(b\!>\!\!a\!>\!\!0)\] \[(\mathscr{R}\mu\!\!>\!\!0)\] \[11.4.43\quad\int_{0}^{\infty}\!\frac{J_{0}(at)}{t}\,\,\{1\!-\!J_{0 }(bt)\}dt = 0\quad\,(0\!<\!\!b\!\leq\!a)\] \[= \ln\frac{b}{a}\,\,(b\!\geq\!\!a\!>\!\!0)\]
